output:
### Summary

I read all four files in full plus the diff, `tests/lib.sh`, `scripts/gate.sh` and the logged gate run. I ran 20 experiments on a scratch copy at `/tmp/sfh.QSbR9m`, with no writes to the worktree. `tests/run` itself does what criterion 1 says, and the new harness test catches 6 of 8 mutations I applied. The CI half does not deliver the issue's goal: on almost every red gate the upload step will fail and upload nothing, because scenario `22-dirty-tree` leaves a file with a newline in its name and `actions/upload-artifact@v4` rejects such paths. Criterion 2 is met on paper only. The rest are lesser gaps: the keep step can abort the gate mid-suite with no verdict line, and the artifact silently omits some data.

One thing I could not do: run the real upload action end to end. The permission classifier denied executing the downloaded action bundle, so the action half of the HIGH finding rests on reading its source at the pinned tag and running its 24-line path check verbatim against a real kept dir.

### Findings

#### CRITICAL

None.

#### HIGH

- **Title:** The upload step fails and uploads nothing whenever `22-dirty-tree` has run
- **Location:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:43-48` (upload step), triggered by `tests/22-dirty-tree.sh:123`
- **Description:** `tests/22-dirty-tree.sh:123` creates `test-<pid>-newline/notes\n.txt` in the scenario's cwd, and nothing removes it. With `BLAST_OFF_TEST_KEEP` set, that file lands in the keep dir. `actions/upload-artifact@v4` rejects any path containing `" : < > | * ? \r \n`, before it creates the artifact, and fails the step.
  - **Measured, keep-dir half:** I ran the real `22-dirty-tree.sh` as a fixture with the keep dir set. It passed in 12 s and kept 623 entries, 98 of them non-hidden files, one being `22-dirty-tree/cwd/test-702913-newline/notes\n.txt`.
  - **Measured, action half:** I copied `invalidArtifactFilePathCharacters` and `validateFilePath` verbatim from the action's `dist/upload/index.js` (v4.6.2, commit `ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02`, which is what `v4` resolves to today) and ran them over those 98 paths. Result: `files checked=98 rejected=1`, with the message `The path for one of the files in artifact is not valid: /22-dirty-tree/cwd/test-702913-newline/notes…`.
  - **Read, not run:** in the same bundle, `uploadArtifact` calls `getUploadZipSpecification` (which validates every path, lines 3672-3700) before `getBackendIdsFromToken` and `CreateArtifact`. The top-level handler at line 125683 is `run().catch(error => core.setFailed(error.message))`. So one bad path means zero files uploaded and a failed step.
  - **Impact:** the suite does not stop at a failing scenario, so `22` runs in every red gate, including a shellcheck-only failure. The artifact is lost in every case except when `22` itself fails before line 123 or the suite aborts before `22`. The harness test cannot catch this; it never exercises the upload.
  - **Not reproduced:** the real action end to end. A PR with a deliberately failing scenario would confirm it in one CI run.
- **Suggested fix:** Tar the keep dir in an `if: failure()` step and upload the tarball (`tar -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" -czf "$RUNNER_TEMP/blast-off-tests.tgz" blast-off-tests`). That is immune to file names and also fixes the hidden-file finding below. Deleting the file at the end of `22` is not enough: a `22` that fails after line 123 exits before any cleanup.

#### MEDIUM

- **Title:** A failed `mv` or `rm` in the keep step aborts the gate mid-suite with no verdict line
- **Location:** `tests/run:34`
- **Description:** Under `set -e`, a failure of `rm -rf "${KEEP:?}/$name"` or `mv "$work" "$KEEP/$name"` ends `tests/run` on the spot.
  - **Measured (E2):** three scenarios, keep dir made unwritable during scenario 1. Output was `PASS 01-a`, then `mv: cannot move … Permission denied`, rc=1. There was no `GATE:` line, scenarios 2 and 3 never ran, and the work dir was left in `TMPDIR`.
  - **Measured (E4):** a scenario that leaves a read-only dir passes on the first keep run (rc=0). The second run with the same keep dir dies at `rm: cannot remove …/ro/f: Permission denied`, rc=1, no verdict, scenario 2 unrun.
  - The var-unset path has the same abort on its `rm -rf "$work"` (measured, pre-existing). This change adds two more abort points, owned by a diagnostics-only feature.
  - The header's contract (`Exit: 0 "GATE: PASS ..." · 1 "GATE: FAIL ..."`) and spec §6 "one verdict line" do not hold on this path. No current scenario triggers it (the only `chmod` calls are `+x`).
- **Suggested fix:** Make a keep failure a counted, named failure instead of an abort: `mv … || { echo "FAIL keep $name"; failed=$((failed+1)); }`, so the loop continues and the verdict line still prints.

- **Title:** A keep dir under `bin/`, `lib/` or `tests/` makes the gate fail on its own kept files
- **Location:** `tests/run:19,34` against `tests/run:42`; header `tests/run:7-8`
- **Description:** The shellcheck pass globs `"$REPO"/tests/**` after the scenarios have been moved into the keep dir.
  - **Measured (E7):** in a mini repo, var unset gives `PASS shellcheck (2 files)`, `GATE: PASS`, rc=0. With `BLAST_OFF_TEST_KEEP=tests/kept` the same repo gives SC2034 on `tests/kept/01-ok/cwd/fixture.sh`, `GATE: FAIL … shellcheck=fail`, rc=1.
  - On the real suite this is guaranteed: `00-harness` leaves `self/tests/fakes/claude` containing `x=1`, written to fail shellcheck. I ran shellcheck on the kept copy and it reports SC2034.
  - A relative value passed through `scripts/gate.sh` resolves against the repo root (`gate.sh:9` does `cd` first), which makes an in-repo keep dir the likely local choice. The failure is loud but points at the wrong cause, and the header does not warn about it.
- **Suggested fix:** Refuse a keep dir inside `$REPO/bin`, `$REPO/lib` or `$REPO/tests` at line 19, or say so in the header.

#### LOW

- **Title:** The artifact silently omits hidden files
- **Location:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:45-48`
- **Description:** The action's `include-hidden-files` defaults to `'false'` (its `action.yml:43-47`). In the kept `22-dirty-tree` dir, that drops every `.git` dir: 2.6M on disk, 516K without them. For the dirty-tree scenario the repo state is the thing under test. The ci.yml comment "every scenario's work dir" overstates what is uploaded.
- **Suggested fix:** The tarball fix covers it; otherwise set `include-hidden-files: true`.

- **Title:** The upload is skipped on cancel or job timeout, and the in-flight scenario is never in the keep dir
- **Location:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:44`; `tests/run:27,34`
- **Description:** A work dir reaches the keep dir only after its scenario ends. If the step is killed, the scenario that was running stays in `/tmp`. `if: failure()` should not fire on a cancelled job; I could not confirm from documentation how a `timeout-minutes: 30` expiry is classed. A scenario that hits `BLAST_OFF_TEST_TIMEOUT` is handled correctly (measured, see Validated).
- **Suggested fix:** `if: failure() || cancelled()`.

- **Title:** The user journal is not captured
- **Location:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:43-48`
- **Description:** Scenarios 11, 12 and 31 start the runner as a transient unit with journald output. Anything a unit prints before `run.log` exists goes only to the journal. Those systemd scenarios are the likeliest CI-only failures. This is outside the acceptance criteria.
- **Suggested fix:** On failure, `journalctl --user --no-pager > "$RUNNER_TEMP/blast-off-tests/journal.txt"` before the upload.

- **Title:** Stale dirs in a reused keep dir read as part of the current run
- **Location:** `tests/run:34`
- **Description:** Only `<keep>/<name>` of a scenario that runs is replaced. Measured (E5): after renaming a scenario, the keep dir holds both `01-new` and `01-old`. This cannot happen in CI (fresh `runner.temp`); it can locally.
- **Suggested fix:** State it in the header, or clear `$KEEP/[0-9][0-9]-*` at start.

- **Title:** `rm -rf "${KEEP:?}/$name"` deletes a pre-existing dir of that name without a message
- **Location:** `tests/run:34`
- **Description:** Measured (E8): `e8keep/01-ok/notes.txt` was gone after the run, with nothing printed. This needs a keep dir pointed at a directory that already has scenario-named subdirs, so it is unlikely.
- **Suggested fix:** A header note is enough.

- **Title:** A keep dir that cannot be made exits 1 with no `GATE:` line
- **Location:** `tests/run:19`
- **Description:** Measured (E1): output was `mkdir: cannot create directory …: Not a directory`, rc=1, no verdict line. The comment on line 18 marks the early failure as intended; the missing verdict line is not mentioned and contradicts the `Exit:` header line.
- **Suggested fix:** Print `GATE: FAIL … (keep dir)` before exiting, or note the exception in the header.

- **Title:** Gaps in the harness test
- **Location:** `tests/00-harness.sh:28-37`
- **Description:**
  - A mutant that merges into an existing kept dir instead of replacing it (`mkdir -p; cp -a "$work/." …`) passes the test (M7). Line 34 checks only for a nested `tmp.*`.
  - Removing the absolute-path resolution on `tests/run:19` also passes (M8). That code is not load-bearing today, because the main shell never changes directory.
  - Line 36 asserts only a non-zero exit for the unset run, not its verdict. A run that crashed before any scenario would satisfy lines 36-37. Lines 12-20 cover the unset verdicts, so this is redundancy.
  - Not tested: a timed-out scenario's dir is kept, an absolute keep path (what CI uses), a keep dir on another filesystem. All three work when run by hand.
- **Suggested fix:** Before the second run, drop a marker file in `kept/01-ok/` and assert it is gone afterwards; grep the verdict on line 36.

- **Title:** New dependency is on a floating tag, and the keep path is written twice
- **Location:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:37,45,48`
- **Description:**
  - The only new dependency is the GitHub Action `actions/upload-artifact@v4`. It is a mutable major tag, not SHA-pinned; today it resolves to v4.6.2, commit `ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02`. It declares `using: node20`. Majors v5, v6 and v7 exist. This matches the existing `actions/checkout@v4` style.
  - No new shell tools: `mv`, `rm`, `mkdir` were already assumed.
  - `${{ runner.temp }}/blast-off-tests` is written on line 37 and again on line 48 and can drift.
  - `if-no-files-found` is left at `warn`, so a red run with an empty keep dir ends with a passing upload step and no artifact.
- **Suggested fix:** Pin by SHA if the repo wants that; set the path once as a job-level `env`.

### Validated

**Confirmed correct**

- **Keep, both ways (criterion 1):** baseline `00-harness` as a fixture gives `PASS 00-harness`, `GATE: PASS passed=1 failed=0 shellcheck=skipped`, rc=0. The kept tree has `00-harness/out` and `00-harness/cwd/…`.
- **The test detects 6 of 8 mutants of `tests/run`:**

  | Mutant | Result |
  |---|---|
  | M1: no `unset BLAST_OFF_TEST_KEEP` | FAIL, "keep fixture verdict … passed=0 failed=2" |
  | M2: no `rm` before `mv` | FAIL, "second run nested", `kept/01-ok/tmp.ZHyAcvC37w` |
  | M3: unset path leaves the dir | FAIL, "work dirs left with BLAST_OFF_TEST_KEEP unset" |
  | M4: copy instead of move | FAIL, "kept work dirs also left in TMPDIR" |
  | M5: never keep | FAIL, "failed scenario's output not kept" |
  | M6: keep only `out` | FAIL, "scenario's cwd not kept" |
  | M7: merge into the old kept dir | PASS (gap, see LOW) |
  | M8: no absolute-path resolution | PASS (gap, see LOW) |

- **Scenarios never see the var:** `tests/run:21` unsets it before the loop; M1 proves the fixture at `00-harness.sh:26` would catch its removal.
- **Timed-out scenario is kept (E3):** `BLAST_OFF_TEST_TIMEOUT=1` with a `sleep 30` scenario gives `FAIL 01-hang`, `GATE: FAIL passed=0 failed=1`, and `e3keep/01-hang/out` contains `started`.
- **Cross-filesystem keep dir works (E6):** with a tmpfs in a private mount namespace and a scenario leaving a file, a FIFO and a dangling symlink, the result is rc=0, all three present under the keep dir, `TMPDIR` empty.
- **`set -e` applies inside the `|| { … }` group on `tests/run:19`:** E1 exits 1 before any scenario.
- **Unset path is unchanged:** the diff's else branch is the old `rm -rf "$work"`; M3 shows the test pins it.
- **Workflow permissions are sufficient:** `contents: read` is enough, since the action authenticates with the runtime token, not `GITHUB_TOKEN` scopes (`getBackendIdsFromToken` in the bundle).
- **Criterion 3:** the header at `tests/run:7-8` and the spec row at `docs/spec.md:215` both describe `<dir>/<name>`, `out`, `cwd`, hidden from scenarios, and unset removing the dir. Each matches measured behaviour.
- **No other upload-hostile names found statically:** a grep of `tests/[0-9]*.sh` for file-creating lines with `$'…'` or `: * ? < > | "` in the target finds only `22-dirty-tree.sh:123`. The kept `00-harness` dir has 17 files, 0 rejected, 0 hidden. No `mkfifo` or socket creation appears in `lib/`, `bin/`, `templates/` or `tests/`; the two `ln -s` calls (`23-runner-lock.sh:26`, `61-jev-pick.sh:57`) point at regular files.
- **No secret in the workflow's keep path:** `ci.yml` sets no secret env, and scenarios use `GH_TOKEN=dummy-not-a-token` (`22-dirty-tree.sh:7`).
- **Logged full gate at this commit:** `baton-runner/br-1115-issues/gate-phase-1-iter-1/tests-run.log` ends `GATE: PASS passed=18 failed=0 shellcheck=ok`. That run had the var unset.
- **Cleanup:** the fixture run of `22` left no `blast-off-test-702913*` units.

**Examined, inconclusive**

- **`ci.yml:43-48` end to end:** the real action was not executed (classifier denial). The blocker is a live CI run with a failing scenario.
- **`ci.yml:44` on job timeout:** a web search did not settle whether a `timeout-minutes` expiry satisfies `failure()`. Needs a live run.
- **`ci.yml:47` on re-run:** v4 fails with 409 when the artifact name already exists on the run, and `overwrite` defaults to `'false'`. Whether a re-run attempt counts as the same run is not documented in anything I found. Needs a re-run of a red job.
- **Other scenarios' kept dirs:** only `00` and `22` were run and inspected. Scenarios 11 and 31 call `install_units`, which rewrites `~/.config/systemd/user`, so I did not run them. Their file names were checked by grep only.
- **`using: node20` on today's runners:** not checked. `actions/checkout@v4` has the same exposure.

**Not examined**

- `docs/spec.md` beyond line 215 was read in full but not checked against code; the diff touches only that row.
- The keep step under the full 18-scenario suite (total artifact size, upload time). Full runs were out of bounds.
- `ci.yml` steps before `tests/run` (dependencies, linger): unchanged by this commit.

### Confidence

High on the `tests/run` findings, all measured. High on the upload rejection logic (real scenario output run through the action's own code), short of certain only because the action never ran end to end; one CI run with a deliberately failing scenario would close that.

Scratch evidence is in `/tmp/sfh.QSbR9m`: `art22` is the kept dir from scenario 22, `validate.js` is the action's path check, `ua/src` is the action source.
